items.title: Boy with scalp ripped open waited two days for medical flight to Perth

items.title: FBI involved in locating bodies of Jake and Callum Robinson in Mexico, court hears

image.altText: Two men in wetsuits stand together near water

children.content: The bodies of two Australian men and their American friend who were shot dead while on a surfing trip in Mexico in 2024 were found through the United States FBI, a murder trial hears.

items.title: Perth man once charged over backpacker's murder breaks silence after 20 years

children.content: More than two decades after he last spoke publicly, Tobias Moran tells the ABC he did not kill his girlfriend Simone Strobel in Lismore in 2005 and accuses the police of unfairly targeting him.

items.title: Years of waiting for diagnosis causing mental distress for women

children.content: For Samantha Banton, accessing an endometriosis diagnosis in WA's Pilbara took a significant toll on her mental health, and new research indicates she is not alone.

image.altText: Samantha Banton is a blonde woman wearing a light pink tshirt. She stands at her glass backdoor looking out to the backyard.

items.title: Small town's lasting effort to remember horrific chapter of Australian military history

children.content: Bill Beard's last message to his sister June was a note scrawled in the notorious Japanese POW camp, acknowledging his birthday. He died a month before the end of the war.

image.altText: Old black and white photograph of solider

children.content: A burst water main in Canning Vale in Perth causes a car to plunge into a sinkhole overnight and impacts the water supply to nearby homes.

items.title: New map could reshape the way you see the world

children.content: For centuries, our understanding of nations across the globe has been laid out by a single map projection of the world. The United Nations just voted to change that.

image.altText: People walking over a tiled floor depiction of a brown world map shown in the pages of a book.

items.title: Student visa refusals hit 10-year high, shattering dreams

children.content: Australia's student visa refusal rate hits a 10-year high, with countries such as Nepal and India facing rejections of more than 40 per cent.

items.title: Australians face night at London's Heathrow Airport after flight cancellation

children.content: Australian travellers have been left stranded at one of the world's busiest airports after an air traffic control failure led to flight cancellations across the United Kingdom.

image.altText: A photo of a man and woman standing on chairs at Heathrow Airport.

items.title: 'Absolutely shocking': Tip-offs allege solar battery rebate fraud

children.content: Almost 100 whistleblower tip-offs claim dodgy operators are rorting a multi-billion-dollar taxpayer-funded solar battery program by mocking up installs, forging signatures and using unlicensed tradies for cash jobs.

image.altText: Solar panels on the roof of a Brisbane home.

items.title: Border Force seizes 1.7m cigarettes, thousands of vapes in WA, NT raids

children.content: The Australian Border Force has seized more than 1.7 million illegal cigarettes and thousands of vapes with a street value of more than $800,000 in a joint operation across Western Australian and the Northern Territory.

image.altText: Two workers in high-vis vests loading seized products into a van, another worker in high-vis stands nearby with a pile of boxes.

items.title: ASX falls to fresh six-week low, Middle East flare-up drives oil towards $US100

children.content: The Australian share market has wiped out its early gains and dropped to a fresh six-week low. It comes after reports of explosions near Iran's Kharg Island, and Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen attacking Saudi energy facilities, setting oil installations ablaze. Follow live.

image.altText: Picture of stock market board with ASX sign at the top left corner.

items.title: Abusive ex-partners rack up millions in debts for victims through tax system

children.content: Perpetrators of domestic violence would be punished rather than rewarded for their actions when committing abuse against their former partners through the tax and super systems.

image.altText: A graphic of anonymous mum and two boys, in front of a home, all sepia toned.

items.title: Socceroo Cristian Volpato's fate uncertain after failed cocaine test

children.content: Cristian Volpato's immediate availability for the Socceroos rests in the hands of Football Australia after NSW Police confirmed the World Cup star had tested positive for cocaine on a secondary test.

image.altText: Soccer player walking on the pitch, breathing heavily

items.title: Tears flow as tennis star lets two-set lead slip in first major quarterfinal

children.content: Rising American star Alex Michelsen is consoled by Frances Tiafoe after losing their US Open quarterfinal despite leading by two sets and a break.

image.altText: Frances Tiafoe hugs Alex Michelsen after their US Open match.

children.content: The decision to introduce private investment into the Big Bash leagues risks leaving cricket in Australia "strategically and financially worse off", according to Cricket NSW.
